submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE was 0.0368% at Sb=0.33. Across Sb fraction, EQE rises then falls: 0.264→0.0081, 0.33→0.0368, 0.362→0.0309, 0.502→0.0111, 0.657→0.00025. XRD shows a single pyrochlore-type phase at Sb 0.305–0.362, with the lattice contracting slightly as Sb increases. By 0.43, a new reflection appears (Q≈3.22) and the intensity ratios change, pointing to phase mixing. The optimum lies in the single-phase window near Sb≈0.33.
